body.statement: For all \(n\ge1\), \(d\ge2\), and \(0<\epsilon<1/2\), the computable estimator \(\widehat G_{\mathrm{emp}}\) is \(\mathcal P([-1,1])\)-valued and satisfies \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{d,\epsilon}}E_{P^n}[W_1(\widehat G_{\mathrm{emp}},G_P)^2]\le C_\epsilon U_{n,d}\).
body.justification: This is a total estimator on the original class and supplies a sharp dense-regime achievability check without trimming null cells.
body.gap: ZengBalakrishnanHanKennedy2024 bounds scalar plug-in estimators, and VinayakKongKakade2019Change assumes fixed repeated trials; neither gives this probability-valued observational law estimator.
body.consumer: It gives an immediately implementable conservative law estimate for saturated categorical PONV profiles.
